moments.title: Wales vs Norway in Cardiff
moments.blurb: Wales' men's national football team takes on Norway in a UEFA Nations League match at Cardiff City Stadium this Thursday.

angles.name: Match Day Hype

moments.title: Duran Duran UK Tour Kicks Off
moments.blurb: Duran Duran's highly anticipated UK arena tour begins this October, with dates across the country culminating in a special Halloween party at London's O2 Arena.

angles.name: Tour Start Excitement
angles.copy: The Wild Boys are back! Duran Duran's UK arena tour kicks off this October. Which date are you heading to?

angles.copy: Fancy a 'Danse Macabre' this Halloween? Duran Duran's UK tour ends with a spectacular O2 Arena party on Oct 31st!

moments.title: Cardiff Music City Festival Begins
moments.blurb: Cardiff Music City Festival transforms the Welsh capital into a hub of live music from October 2nd to 17th, showcasing established, emerging, and local talent across multiple venues.

angles.name: Festival Launch
angles.copy: Cardiff Music City Festival kicks off Friday! Get ready for two weeks of incredible live music across the city. Who are you excited to see?

angles.name: Discover New Music
angles.copy: From established acts to rising stars, Cardiff Music City Festival (Oct 2-17) is the perfect chance to discover your new favourite artist. #LiveMusic

moments.title: Happy 42nd Birthday T-Pain
moments.blurb: Grammy-winning rapper and producer T-Pain, known for popularising auto-tune and hits like 'Buy U a Drank', turns 42 today.

angles.name: Birthday Shout-out
angles.copy: Happy 42nd Birthday to the one and only T-Pain! What's your favourite track from the king of auto-tune?

angles.name: Auto-Tune Legacy
angles.copy: He changed the game! T-Pain turns 42 today. Raise a glass to the artist who brought auto-tune to the masses.

moments.title: Happy 91st Birthday Johnny Mathis
moments.blurb: Legendary American singer Johnny Mathis, whose career spans over 60 years with hits like 'Chances Are' and 'Misty', celebrates his 91st birthday today.

angles.name: Birthday Tribute
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 91st Birthday to the incredible Johnny Mathis! His timeless voice has soundtracked generations. What's your favourite Mathis classic?

angles.name: Voice of Romance
angles.copy: The 'Voice of Romance' himself, Johnny Mathis, is 91 today! Still captivating audiences worldwide. Sending him all our love.

moments.title: Two Moors Festival Begins in Devon
moments.blurb: The internationally recognised Two Moors Festival, a classical music event set across Dartmoor and Exmoor, starts its 2026 edition from October 1st to 11th.

angles.name: Festival Opening
angles.copy: Get ready for world-class music in stunning settings! The Two Moors Festival begins tomorrow, bringing classical performances to Dartmoor & Exmoor until Oct 11th. #TwoMoorsFestival

angles.name: Culture on the Moors
angles.copy: Classical music meets breathtaking landscapes as the Two Moors Festival kicks off on Thursday! Explore the unique venues and incredible talent across Devon and Somerset.

moments.title: Enjoy Exeter's First Monthly Evening
moments.blurb: Exeter launches 'Enjoy Exeter' tomorrow, a new monthly evening event on the first Thursday of each month, encouraging residents and visitors to shop, dine, and explore the city's offerings.

angles.name: Local Event Hype
angles.copy: Get ready to 'Enjoy Exeter' tomorrow evening! Shops staying open later, special offers, and a great chance to explore our city. See you there! #EnjoyExeter

angles.copy: Support local and have some fun! The first 'Enjoy Exeter' monthly evening is tomorrow. What's your favourite Exeter spot you'll be visiting?
